onChange.script:
result = self.custom.result
	if result and result.get('status') in ('SUCCESS', 'TRANSFER_PENDING'):
		return
	message = self.custom.errorMessage
	if not message:
		return
	system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': message})
	lower = message.lower()
	if 'uncertain' in lower or 'supervisor' in lower or 'could not load' in lower or 'reconcile' in lower:
		system.perspective.openPopup('receivingErrorDetail', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/messagePopup', {'text': message}, title='Receiving error', modal=True)
	return

result = self.custom.result
	if not result:
		return
	status = result.get('status')
	data = result.get('data') or {}
	order = self.custom.order or {}
	orderNumber = data.get('orderNumber') or order.get('orderNumber') or 'this order'
	lotName = data.get('lotName') or '-'
	quantity = data.get('quantityKg')
	quantityText = str(quantity) if quantity is not None else '-'
	truckName = data.get('truckName') or '-'
	tankName = data.get('tankName') or '-'
	unitText = order.get('unitName') or 'kg'
	if status == 'SUCCESS':
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Receipt complete for order %s: lot %s, %s %s, truck %s, tank %s.' % (orderNumber, lotName, quantityText, unitText, truckName, tankName)})
	elif status == 'TRANSFER_PENDING':
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Receipt recorded for order %s: lot %s (%s %s) remains at truck %s. Open Pending Transfers to complete the move to tank %s.' % (orderNumber, lotName, quantityText, unitText, truckName, tankName)})
	return

message = self.custom.warningMessage
	if not message:
		return
	system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': message})
	return

config.script:
if self.view.custom.submitting:
		return
	if not self.view.custom.order:
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'No eligible order was selected. Return to the schedule and select an order.'
		return
	if self.view.custom.actualQtyKg is None or self.view.custom.truckAssetId is None or self.view.custom.tankAssetId is None:
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'Enter an actual quantity and select a receiving truck and destination tank.'
		return
	unitOfOrder = self.view.custom.order.get('unitName') or 'kg'
	qtyText = ('{:,.3f}'.format(float(self.view.custom.actualQtyKg))).rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
	msg = 'Confirm receipt of %s %s for order %s?' % (qtyText, unitOfOrder, self.view.custom.order.get('orderNumber') or 'this order')
	system.perspective.openPopup('receiptConfirmPopup', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text': msg, 'messageHandler': 'confirmReceiveOrder'}, title='Confirm receipt', modal=True)
	return

transforms.code:
if value['submitting']: return False
	if (value['result'] or {}).get('status') in ('SUCCESS', 'TRANSFER_PENDING'): return False
	if value['received'] is None: return False
	try:
		target = float(value['target'])
	except (TypeError, ValueError):
		return False
	if target <= 0: return False
	return float(value['received'] or 0) < target

messageHandlers.script:
selection = payload.get('selection') or []
	if len(selection) == 0:
		self.view.custom.truckAssetId = None
		self.view.custom.truckPath = None
		return
	value = selection[0].get('value') or {}
	assetId = value.get('assetId')
	if assetId is None or unicode(assetId).strip() == '':
		self.view.custom.truckAssetId = None
		self.view.custom.truckPath = None
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'Select a Storage Location, not a folder.'
		system.perspective.sendMessage('clearSelection', {'selectorId': payload.get('selectorId')})
		return
	self.view.custom.truckAssetId = assetId
	self.view.custom.truckPath = value.get('path') or value.get('assetPath')
	self.view.custom.errorMessage = ''
	return

selection = payload.get('selection') or []
	if len(selection) == 0:
		self.view.custom.tankAssetId = None
		self.view.custom.tankPath = None
		return
	value = selection[0].get('value') or {}
	assetId = value.get('assetId')
	if assetId is None or unicode(assetId).strip() == '':
		self.view.custom.tankAssetId = None
		self.view.custom.tankPath = None
		self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'Select a Storage Location, not a folder.'
		system.perspective.sendMessage('clearSelection', {'selectorId': payload.get('selectorId')})
		return
	self.view.custom.tankAssetId = assetId
	self.view.custom.tankPath = value.get('path') or value.get('assetPath')
	self.view.custom.errorMessage = ''
	return

from threading import RLock
	lockKey = 'kanoaReceivingSubmit:%s:%s' % (self.session.props.id, self.view.id)
	lock = system.util.getGlobals().setdefault(lockKey, RLock())
	with lock:
		priorResult = self.view.custom.result
		if priorResult and priorResult.get('status') in ('SUCCESS', 'TRANSFER_PENDING'):
			return
		if self.view.custom.submitting:
			return
		self.view.custom.submitting = True
		self.view.custom.loading = True
		try:
			workOrderId = self.view.custom.order.get('workOrderId')
			result = kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.receiveOrder(
				workOrderId,
				self.view.custom.actualQtyKg,
				self.view.custom.truckAssetId,
				self.view.custom.tankAssetId,
				self.session.props.auth.user
			)
			self.view.custom.result = result
			if result.get('status') in ('SUCCESS', 'TRANSFER_PENDING'):
				notesDraft = self.view.custom.notesDraft or ''
				if notesDraft != (self.view.custom.orderNotes or ''):
					logger = kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.getLogger()
					logger.info('Receive notes save start workOrderId=%s' % workOrderId)
					try:
						userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
						system.kanoa.order.updateProductionOrderField(workOrderId, 'note', notesDraft, userId)
						self.view.custom.orderNotes = notesDraft
						logger.info('Receive notes save outcome workOrderId=%s status=SAVED' % workOrderId)
					except Exception as notesExc:
						logger.error('Receive notes save failed workOrderId=%s: %s' % (workOrderId, str(notesExc)))
						self.view.custom.warningMessage = 'Receipt recorded, but the notes were not saved. Re-enter them in the work order editor.'
			self.view.custom.errorMessage = '' if result.get('status') in ('SUCCESS', 'TRANSFER_PENDING') else result.get('message', '')
		except Exception as exc:
			kanoaScripts.custom.ops.receiving.getLogger().error('Perspective receive handler failed: %s' % str(exc))
			self.view.custom.errorMessage = 'Receipt outcome may be uncertain. Check Pending Transfers or ask a supervisor before retrying.'
		finally:
			self.view.custom.submitting = False
			self.view.custom.loading = False
	return
